description: Features as a list of disclosures, the first one open, with an optional picture.

files.content:
<!-- Code generated by packages/kit-compose/src/organisms.ts from packages/compose-gen/specs (compose-gen organism emitters on kit-compose). DO NOT EDIT. -->
<!--
  Features as a list of disclosures: icon and title in the summary, the text when open. Axes: expand (first: the
  first one is open, none: all closed), media (none, image: a picture beside the list), tone, density.
-->
<script lang="ts" module>
  import type { Snippet } from "svelte";
  import type { Feature } from "./feature-grid.types";

  export type FeatureAccordionProps = {
    id: string;
    title: string;
    features: Feature[];
    empty?: string;
    expand?: "first" | "none";
    media?: "none" | "image";
    multiple?: boolean;
    tone?: "default" | "muted";
    density?: "default" | "compact";
    landmarkLabel?: string;
  };
</script>

<script lang="ts">
  import Disclosure from "../compose/Disclosure.svelte";
  import Inline from "../compose/Inline.svelte";
  import LucideIcon from "../icons/LucideIcon.svelte";
  import Stack from "../compose/Stack.svelte";
  import Summary from "../compose/Summary.svelte";
  import Text from "../compose/Text.svelte";
  import EmptyState from "../components/empty-state.svelte";
  import MediaFrame from "../components/media-frame.svelte";
  import SectionFrame from "../components/section-frame.svelte";
  import { tpl } from "../utils";

  let {
    id,
    title,
    features,
    empty = "",
    expand = "first",
    media = "none",
    multiple = false,
    tone = "default",
    density = "default",
    landmarkLabel,
  }: FeatureAccordionProps = $props();
</script>

<SectionFrame
  id={id}
  title={title}
  tone={tone}
  density={density}
  layout={(((media as string) === "image") ? "split" : "stack")}
  media={{ show: ((media as string) === "image") }}
  landmarkLabel={landmarkLabel}
>
  {#if ((features?.length ?? 0) === 0)}
    <EmptyState icon="layout-grid" title={empty} />
  {:else}
    <Stack gap="0" align="stretch" data-slot="items">
      {#each features as f, i (f.id)}
        <Disclosure
          variant="item"
          name={(multiple ? undefined : tpl("{0}-accordion", (id ?? "accordion")))}
          open={(((expand as string) === "first") && (i === 0))}
          data-slot="item"
        >
          <Summary variant="item">
            <Inline class="flex min-w-0 items-center justify-start gap-4">
              <LucideIcon name={f.icon} size={20} />
              <Inline class="text-base font-semibold">
                {f.title}
              </Inline>
            </Inline>
          </Summary>
          <Text size="sm" class="pb-4 text-muted-foreground">
            {f.text}
          </Text>
        </Disclosure>
      {/each}
    </Stack>
  {/if}
  {#snippet aside()}
    <MediaFrame alt={title} ratio="4/3" />
  {/snippet}
</SectionFrame>
